title: SceneSpec
description:
A scene: every frame, robot, and entity, version 1.

All ids — of frames, robots, rigs, cameras, lasers, lights, targets, and
parts — share one namespace.

frames.description: Named auxiliary frames (fixtures, mounting plates, tool offsets).

CameraParams.description: Serializable camera parameters for building a runtime model.

CameraSpec.description:
A camera. Its projection model is a calibration-rs [`CameraParams`] —
the same type calibration-rs calibrates and exports.

optics.description: The camera's physical optics, if it has them: then its frame is its body's (ADR 0008).

params.description:
Projection / distortion / sensor / intrinsics. With [`optics`](Self::optics), the
focal lengths, skew and sensor tilt are the equivalent pinhole the optics give.

parent_se3_self.description: Pose of the camera in its parent (maps camera → parent).

CameraTemplate.description: The camera model of every position of a layout.

optics.description: The cameras' physical optics, if they have them (ADR 0008).

oneOf.description:
OpenCV's modern layout: markers on the white squares, numbered row by
row.
No distortion.
Brown-Conrady 5-parameter radial-tangential model.
OpenCV rational polynomial 8-parameter model.
Brown-Conrady + thin-prism 9-parameter model.
Fitzgibbon single-parameter division model.
The whole lens moves along its axis; its focal length does not change.

FrameRef.description:
A reference to a frame: `"world"`, `"<robot_id>/<link_name>"`, or
`"<entity_id>"`. Parse it with [`FrameRef::parse`].

FrameSpec.description: A named auxiliary frame — a fixture, a mounting plate, a TCP offset.

id.description: Unique id (shared namespace with every other entity and robot).

parent_se3_self.description: Pose of this frame in its parent (maps self → parent).

ImageX.description: The direction of a ring camera's image +X.

oneOf.description: Along the ring (counter-clockwise seen from +Z).
Away from the rig axis.

The rig's +X, as each camera sees it: classical stereo. For two cameras on the rig's x
axis the image rows line up (the image +Y axes are the same); with no tilt (a parallel
rig) the image +X axes are the same too.
Pinhole intrinsics with optional skew.

cx.description: Principal point X coordinate in pixels.

cy.description: Principal point Y coordinate in pixels.

fx.description: Focal length in pixels along X.

fy.description: Focal length in pixels along Y.

Iso3Schema.description:
JSON Schema proxy for [`Iso3`] (`nalgebra::Isometry3<f64>`).

`nalgebra` does not implement [`schemars::JsonSchema`], so `*Export` and
parameter types that embed [`Iso3`] annotate the field with
`#[cfg_attr(feature = "schemars", schemars(with = "Iso3Schema"))]`
(or `Vec<Iso3Schema>` / `Option<Iso3Schema>`). This proxy mirrors the exact
serde wire format of `Isometry3`:
`{ "rotation": [qx, qy, qz, qw], "translation": [tx, ty, tz] }`.

It exists only to describe that shape to `schemars`; it is never
constructed at runtime.

rotation.description: Unit quaternion `[qx, qy, qz, qw]` (i, j, k, w order).

azimuth_rad.description: Azimuth of laser `i` relative to camera `i`, radians (unused with `camera_se3_laser`).

beam_waist_m.description: Beam-waist `1/e²` radius at the laser, metres.

camera_se3_laser.description:
Each laser fixed to its camera's body at this pose, as a head carries it; otherwise it
stands on the ring, aimed at the working point.

fan_length.description: Fan reach along its central ray, metres.

radius_m.description: Distance of each laser from the rig axis, metres (unused with `camera_se3_laser`).

LaserSpec.description:
A line laser: a flat fan with a Gaussian-beam cross-section (the
`etendue-core` `LaserEntity` parameters).

beam_waist_m.description: Beam-waist `1/e²` radius at the laser origin, in metres.

camera.description:
The camera that images this laser's line, in a rig with one laser
per camera: its laser images and laser-plane calibration use this
laser only. Lasers that name cameras must name different ones.

fan_half_angle.description: Fan half-angle in radians, in `(0, π/2)`.

fan_length.description: Fan reach along its central ray, in metres.

parent_se3_self.description: Pose of the laser in its parent (maps laser → parent).

power_w.description:
Optical power in watts, as the camera responds to it (its spectral
response at the wavelength folded in), spread evenly over the fan's
angle. Only laser images use it; absent, they take etendue-synth's
default (0.5 mW).

LensOptics.description: An ideal thick lens with its entrance pupil.

entrance_pupil_m.description: Signed distance from H to the entrance pupil, metres (positive toward the object).

f_number.description: f-number: the focal length over the entrance pupil diameter.

name.description: What the lens is, e.g. `Kowa LM25HC`.

principal_gap_m.description:
Signed distance from the rear principal point H′ to the front one H, metres (positive
when H lies on the object side).

oneOf.description: Isotropic point (or small sphere) light.

radius_m.description: Emitter radius in metres (`0` = ideal point).

oneOf.description: Cone light along local +Z.

blend.description: Soft-edge fraction of the cone, in `[0, 1]`.

cone_angle.description: Full cone angle in radians, in `(0, π)`.

oneOf.description: Rectangular area light in the local `z = 0` plane, emitting along +Z.

color.description: Linear RGB colour, each channel in `[0, 1]`.

parent_se3_self.description: Pose of the light in its parent (maps light → parent).

MarkerCircle.description: A marker board circle: on square `(i, j)` (column, row), white or black.

focus_distance_m.description:
Distance from the image-plane datum to the plane in focus, metres, as a lens's focus scale
reads it.

tilt_rad.description:
The sensor's tilt `[τx, τy]` about the image-plane datum, radians, in calibration-rs's
(OpenCV's) convention.

PartSpec.description: A passive rigid part rendered from a mesh (a fixture, a workpiece).

mesh.description:
Mesh file (glTF binary), path relative to the scene file. Vertices
are in the part frame, metres.

parent_se3_self.description: Pose of the part in its parent (maps part → parent).

oneOf.description: A white disk on a dark square.
A black disk on a light square.

PrintedTarget.description:
A target as calib-targets prints it, tagged on `kind`. Sizes are in
millimetres, as on the print.

Planar targets lie in the target frame's `z = 0` plane, centred on its
origin, facing +Z, the print's top edge at +Y. A PuzzlePole is a cylinder:
its frame is calib-targets' pole object frame (axis +Z, origin on the axis
in the plane of axial corner 0, the seam at +X).

oneOf.description: A chessboard.

inner_square_rel.description: White inset in the black squares, as a fraction of the side.

oneOf.description: A ChArUco board.

inner_square_rel.description: White inset in the plain black squares, as a fraction of the side.

marker_size_rel.description: Marker side as a fraction of the square side.

oneOf.description: A chessboard with three circles that fix its origin and orientation.

circle_diameter_rel.description: Circle diameter as a fraction of the square side.

inner_square_rel.description: White inset in the black squares, as a fraction of the side.

oneOf.description:
A PuzzleBoard: a chessboard whose edge dots make every corner
self-identifying.

dot_diameter_rel.description: Edge-dot diameter as a fraction of the square side.

origin_col.description: Master column of the board's first square.

origin_row.description: Master row of the board's first square.

oneOf.description:
A PuzzlePole: a PuzzleBoard strip wrapped around a cylinder of
circumference `circumference_squares × square_size_mm`.

axial_start_col.description: Master column the strip is cut from.

circumference_squares.description:
Squares around the circumference: a supported period (12, 18,
24, 30, 36 or 42).

dot_diameter_rel.description: Edge-dot diameter as a fraction of the square side.

start_row.description:
Master row the strip is cut from (the seam); must match the
period (see calib-targets `PuzzlePolePeriod`).

oneOf.description: Classic pinhole model.

RigLayout.description: How a rig's cameras (and lasers) are laid out.

image_x.description: Which way each camera's image +X points.

lasers.description: One laser per camera, if any.

phase_rad.description: Azimuth of camera 0 about the rig axis, radians.

radius_m.description:
Distance of each camera from the rig axis, metres (`0` only for one
camera).

tilt_rad.description:
Angle between each camera's axis and the rig axis, radians; default
`atan(radius / working_distance)`.

working_distance_m.description:
Where the camera axes meet the rig axis (with the default tilt), and
where the lasers aim: `(0, 0, working_distance_m)` in the rig frame.

RigSpec.description:
A rigid mount that groups cameras (and optionally lasers). Cameras attach
to it with `parent_se3_self = rig_se3_cam`, the direction of calibration-rs
`DeviceSpec` `rig_se3_cam`.

layout.description:
The layout its cameras and lasers were made from, kept so it can be
edited again (`RigLayout::expand`). The cameras and lasers are the
source of truth; this is not checked against them.

parent_se3_self.description: Pose of the rig in its parent (maps rig → parent).

RobotSpec.description:
A robot placed in a scene.

The robot contributes one frame per URDF link, named
`"<id>/<link_name>"`. `parent_se3_self` places the manifest's
[`base_link`](RobotManifest::base_link) in the parent frame.

id.description: Unique id (shared namespace with every entity).

initial_q.description:
Joint positions at `t = 0`, in manifest joint order (rad or m).
Defaults to all zeros.

manifest.description: Path to the robot's `robot.json` manifest, relative to the scene file.

parent.description: Parent frame of the robot base.

parent_se3_self.description: Pose of the robot base link in its parent (`parent_se3_base`).

name.description: What the sensor is, e.g. `Sony IMX174`.

oneOf.description: Identity sensor model.
Homography applied in the sensor plane.

h.description: Row-major homography matrix mapping normalized to sensor coordinates.

oneOf.description: Scheimpflug/tilted sensor model.

tilt_x.description: Tilt around X axis in radians (alias: tau_x).

tilt_y.description: Tilt around Y axis in radians (alias: tau_y).

oneOf.description:
A calibration board, described in the calibration-rs dataset
vocabulary (the same `TargetSpec` a synthetic `DatasetSpec` emits).
The board is centred on the local origin in the `z = 0` plane, facing
+Z. The in-plane mapping from board (feature) coordinates to the
target frame is defined once, by `etendue-synth`: the printed board
reads correctly from +Z, its top edge at +Y.

board.description:
Board layout (`kind`-tagged: chessboard, charuco, puzzleboard,
ringgrid).

oneOf.description:
A target as calib-targets prints it — chessboard, ChArUco, marker
board, PuzzleBoard, or the PuzzlePole cylinder — with its print
parameters (millimetres). Unlike `board`, every kind is drawn,
ground-truthed and detected; only those calibration-rs takes go into
a calibration dataset.

A plain rectangle centred on the local origin in the `z = 0` plane
(the `etendue-core` `TargetEntity`).

height.description: Extent along local Y, in metres.

width.description: Extent along local X, in metres.

parent.description:
Parent frame (`"world"`, a fixture, or `"<robot>/tool0"` for
eye-to-hand).

parent_se3_self.description: Pose of the target in its parent (maps target → parent).

oneOf.description:
Standard checkerboard. Counts are interior corners
(i.e. `9x6` ⇒ a 10×7 black-and-white square grid).

cols.description: Number of interior corners along the cols axis.

rows.description: Number of interior corners along the rows axis.

square_size_m.description: Edge length of one square in metres.

oneOf.description:
ChArUco board. Marker IDs and dictionary live here so detection
is fully deterministic from the manifest.

cols.description: Number of squares along the cols axis.

dictionary.description:
ArUco dictionary identifier (e.g. `"DICT_4X4_50"`). The
detector validates this against the supported set.

marker_size_m.description: Edge length of an embedded marker in metres.

rows.description:
Number of squares along the rows axis (full grid, not
interior corners).

square_size_m.description: Edge length of one square in metres.

oneOf.description:
Puzzleboard target (calib-targets crate). Layout is fully
described by the named variant in calib-targets; the manifest
just carries the discriminator.

cell_size_m.description: Edge length of one cell in metres.

oneOf.description:
Coded ring-grid target (the `ringgrid` crate). The board is a
hex-lattice of self-identifying ring markers; its geometry mirrors
`ringgrid::BoardLayout` so the manifest fully determines detection.

long_row_cols.description:
Number of columns in the longest (even-indexed) row. Shorter
rows are derived by the hex-lattice layout.

marker_ring_width_m.description: Width of each ring band in metres.

pitch_m.description: Center-to-center spacing between adjacent markers in metres.
